mukta-m0-p51-v1251.quick_english: With silk-cotton flowers and perfected substances for a month, one becomes fearless.

mukta-m0-p51-v1252.quick_english: In a lonely forest at night for a month, one becomes fearless.

mukta-m0-p51-v1253.quick_english: Jasmine, champak, screw-pine, ketaki, and honey are used in order.

mukta-m0-p51-v1254.quick_english: Worship may be done in a cremation ground, caṇḍikā house, or lonely forest.

mukta-m0-p51-v1255.quick_english: In the black circle, salute and worship the very black goddess.

mukta-m0-p51-v1256.quick_english: Endowed with perfected substances for a month, that bhāva appears to sight.

mukta-m0-p51-v1257.quick_english: Satisfied with universal destruction, she returns again by her own will.

mukta-m0-p51-v1258.quick_english: By prayer, the goddess's forehead eye becomes hidden.

mukta-m0-p51-v1259.quick_english: In a lonely garden, contemplate the goddess in the circle and worship her.

mukta-m0-p51-v1260.quick_english: Endowed with perfected substances, illusions succeed after a month.

mukta-m0-p51-v1261.quick_english: By whom the universe is traversed, that world-wandering, world-delighting one goes.

mukta-m0-p51-v1262.quick_english: Contemplating the goddess properly in those places, one becomes a knower of three times.

mukta-m0-p51-v1263.quick_english: Dwelling there with those flowers, one becomes cupid-like.

mukta-m0-p51-v1264.quick_english: Rites and mantras sent by others are averted and indeed devoured.

mukta-m0-p51-v1265.quick_english: Worship done for a year becomes complete.

mukta-m0-p51-v1266.quick_english: Then ash became; the wife, delight, and pleasure were distressed.

mukta-m0-p51-v1251.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1251.question: What offerings and duration establish fearless practice in this rite?
mukta-m0-p51-v1251.inference: The practitioner becomes fearless through a month of worship with specified substances.
uncertainties: exact ritual context is not fully stated

mukta-m0-p51-v1252.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1252.question: Where and when does the fearless rite take place?
premises: the place is a lonely forest
mukta-m0-p51-v1252.inference: Fearlessness is attained by practicing in a lonely forest at night for a month.
uncertainties: whether this is a separate rite or continuation

mukta-m0-p51-v1253.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1253.question: Which flowers and substance are used in ordered worship?
mukta-m0-p51-v1253.inference: The rite employs these flowers and honey in a prescribed sequence.
uncertainties: exact ritual application is not stated

mukta-m0-p51-v1254.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1254.question: Where may this worship be performed?
mukta-m0-p51-v1254.inference: The practitioner may worship in any of these secluded or sacred places.
uncertainties: whether all locations suit every rite

mukta-m0-p51-v1255.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1255.question: How is the goddess worshipped in the black circle?
premises: the black circle is the place
the very black goddess is addressed
mukta-m0-p51-v1255.inference: The practitioner salutes and then worships the very black goddess in the black circle.
uncertainties: identity of the goddess is not explicit

mukta-m0-p51-v1256.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1256.question: What result follows from perfected substances and a month?
mukta-m0-p51-v1256.inference: After a month with perfected substances, a bhāva becomes visible.
uncertainties: exact meaning of bhāva and locana

mukta-m0-p51-v1257.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1257.question: What happens when the goddess is satisfied with universal destruction?
premises: she acts by her own will
mukta-m0-p51-v1257.inference: The satisfied goddess returns and acts according to her own will.
uncertainties: whether destruction is literal or symbolic

mukta-m0-p51-v1258.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1258.question: What becomes hidden through the goddess's forehead eye?
premises: the goddess's forehead eye is mentioned
mukta-m0-p51-v1258.inference: Through prayer, the goddess's forehead-eye powers become hidden or withdrawn.

mukta-m0-p51-v1259.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1259.question: How is the goddess worshipped in a lonely garden?
premises: the place is a lonely garden
the goddess is contemplated in the circle
mukta-m0-p51-v1259.inference: The practitioner contemplates the goddess in the circle and worships her in a lonely garden.

mukta-m0-p51-v1260.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1260.question: What succeeds through perfected substances after a month?
mukta-m0-p51-v1260.inference: Illusions succeed or are accomplished after a month with perfected substances.
uncertainties: whether māyāḥ are powers or deceptions

mukta-m0-p51-v1261.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1261.question: Who wanders and delights in the universe?
mukta-m0-p51-v1261.inference: The practitioner or goddess becomes a world-wandering, world-delighting being.

mukta-m0-p51-v1262.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1262.question: How does one become a knower of three times?
mukta-m0-p51-v1262.inference: Proper contemplation of the goddess makes one a knower of three times.

mukta-m0-p51-v1263.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1263.question: What results from dwelling there with those flowers?
mukta-m0-p51-v1263.inference: Dwelling there with those flowers makes one cupid-like.

mukta-m0-p51-v1264.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1264.question: What happens to rites and mantras sent by others?
mukta-m0-p51-v1264.inference: Rites and mantras sent by others are averted and devoured.
uncertainties: agent of devouring is not stated

mukta-m0-p51-v1265.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1265.question: What completes a year of worship?
premises: worship is done for a year
it becomes complete by that agent
mukta-m0-p51-v1265.inference: A year of worship becomes complete through the practitioner's performance.

mukta-m0-p51-v1266.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1266.question: What happened to the wife when ash appeared?
mukta-m0-p51-v1266.inference: When ash appeared, the wife, delight, and pleasure were distressed.

mukta-m0-p51-v1267.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1267.question: What qualities were present in that event?
mukta-m0-p51-v1267.inference: The event was marked by great fragrance, auspiciousness, and wonder.

mukta-m0-p51-v1268.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1268.question: Why was Cupid made nature for delight and pleasure?
mukta-m0-p51-v1268.inference: Cupid is established as nature for the sake of delight and pleasure.

mukta-m0-p51-v1269.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1269.question: What worship will be performed for Cupid?
mukta-m0-p51-v1269.inference: A yearly worship for Cupid will be performed.

mukta-m0-p51-v1270.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1270.question: Who must perform Cupid worship?
mukta-m0-p51-v1270.inference: The best practitioners must perform Cupid worship.

mukta-m0-p51-v1271.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1271.question: How is Cupid to be made and worshipped?
mukta-m0-p51-v1271.inference: Cupid is to be made ninefold and then worshipped.
uncertainties: whether making and worshiping are sequential or alternative

mukta-m0-p51-v1272.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1272.question: How is combined Cupid worshipped?
mukta-m0-p51-v1272.inference: Combined Cupid of various kinds is worshipped in order.

mukta-m0-p51-v1273.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1273.question: What flashing pairs are described?
premises: again a flashing pair is named
mukta-m0-p51-v1273.inference: The verse describes flashing pairs of illusion appearing again.

mukta-m0-p51-v1274.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1274.question: What manifest pair appears at the end?
mukta-m0-p51-v1274.inference: At the end, a manifest pair appears again.
uncertainties: meaning of caṭa and manifest pair

mukta-m0-p51-v1275.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p51-v1275.question: What does the fierce mantra ending in phaṭ strike?
mukta-m0-p51-v1275.inference: The fierce phaṭ-ending mantra strikes the pair and armor.
uncertainties: Exact referent of pair and armor remains unclear.

essence: The practitioner becomes fearless through a month of worship with specified substances.
Fearlessness is attained by practicing in a lonely forest at night for a month.
The rite employs these flowers and honey in a prescribed sequence.
The practitioner may worship in any of these secluded or sacred places.
The practitioner salutes and then worships the very black goddess in the black circle.
